# Synthesis map

## Strategies

Two possible strategies

- n interpretations -> n outputs -> mosaic -> assemble -> synthesis
- n interpretations -> 1 aggregate/synthesis -> output -> mosaic

## output first, assemble later

### Stepwise process

1. For each xref, select an EFG, assign membership values to polygons, 
2. rasterize polygons, output one raster, 
3. add raster to EFG folder with source+interpreter+round combination in the name, 
4. mosaic and sum all rasters to one layer for the whole country: one raster per EFG
5. combine all rasters as bands in one file
5. calculate which.max and max value
